name: kb-content
description: Business rules YAML content. Validated in CI; published as a data image to GHCR for the @kb/mcp-server runtime.

scripts.ingest:local: kb-ingest init --db ./kb.db && kb-ingest ingest --db ./kb.db --plugin ./plugin/ingest.mjs --opt root=./rules --opt vault=./vault --opt standards=./standards --opt lessons=./lessons --opt catalogo=./catalogo --opt precedentes=./precedentes && kb-ingest embed --db ./kb.db && kb-ingest status --db ./kb.db
